q: Where can a Site-to-Site VPN pre-shared key be stored besides the VPN service itself?
v: store pre-shared keys (PSKs) in AWS Secrets Manager

ev: A key improvement is the ability to store pre-shared keys (PSKs) in AWS Secrets Manager rather than directly in the Site-to-Site VPN service, allowing for better secret management and compliance with security best practices.
